name: frontend-dependency-matrix
body: The durable per-frontend dependency matrix. Base scanner (`apg`, `scanner-cli`): build Rust plus prebuilt static liblbug 0.19.1 plus network; scan-time deps none; links openssl@3; Linux runtime needs libssl.so.3. Bundled structural scanner (`structfrontend`, `src/structlib`): build stable Rust plus crates.io; scan-time deps none (it performs zero subprocess calls); engine serde/serde_json/unicode-normalization 0.1, with a language-version ceiling of none; ships in the base package rather than a separate formula. Go (`gofrontend`): build Go >= 1.25 (`src/golib/go.mod`, with `toolchain go1.27.1` as the repo-visible floor) plus network for golang.org/x/tools v0.48.0; scan-time `go`; engine x/tools v0.48.0 plus the compiling toolchain's go/types. Java (`java-classes`): build javac with --release 21; scan-time `java` (JDK >= 21), spawned as `java -Xmx5g -cp <dir> CallGraphBuilder`; engine the runtime JDK's javac via ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler(). C++ (`cppfrontend`): build gcc (-std=c11) plus g++ (-std=c++17); scan-time deps none; engine the vendored tree-sitter language ABI v15 plus the vendored tree-sitter-cpp grammar content (`src/cpplib/vendor/tree-sitter-cpp/src/parser.c` plus `scanner.c`), a content/ABI pin, since upstream provides none for the vendored grammar. Rust (`rustfrontend`): build stable Rust plus network (git-pinned ra_ap_* crates); scan-time `cargo` plus `rustc`; engine rust-analyzer tag 2026-08-17 (0.0.348). TypeScript (`tsfrontend`): build node plus npm ci; scan-time `node`; engine typescript 5.9.3. C# (`csharpfrontend`): build .NET SDK plus NuGet; scan-time deps none (self-contained); engine Roslyn Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp(.Workspaces) 4.12.0 at LanguageVersion.Latest. Python (`pyfrontend`): build stable Rust plus network (Ruff git crates); scan-time deps none (filesystem markers, zero subprocesses); engine Ruff/ty tag 0.16.6, salsa 0.27. The former Markdown (`mdfrontend`) row folds into the bundled structural scanner row; `apg-md` retires.
